criterion: The agent retrieves the exact Drive file 'V12 Change Routing Standard 27' (DRV_FILE_V12_STANDARD_27) and confirms it is the current binding source before deriving the selected serial, change fields, incident-update fields, or Teams destination from it.

The agent resolves the selected configuration item's serial through an ITSM find_configuration_item_by_serial_number lookup (returning CI_V12_EDGE_417 / SRV-EDGE-417) before creating the change or sending the Teams message.

The agent enumerates incident records across the new, in_progress, and on_hold containers (surfacing INC_V12_ESC_NEW, INC_V12_ESC_PROGRESS, and INC_V12_ESC_HOLD) via an ITSM list_incidents read before applying any update, rather than guessing incident ids.
Exactly one change request (CHG_001) is created, and it is explicitly tied to the ITSM-resolved configuration item CI_V12_EDGE_417 rather than a value taken directly from the Drive file.

The change's field values (status assess, impact high, risk high, priority critical, category hardware, cab_required true) are explicitly derived from the V12 Change Routing Standard 27's specified change fields rather than defaulted or guessed.

Every in-scope incident (INC_V12_ESC_NEW, INC_V12_ESC_PROGRESS, INC_V12_ESC_HOLD) is updated with the change reference to CHG_001 and the exact work note text 'Escalated under V12 Change Routing Standard 27', matching the standard's specified wording rather than a paraphrase.

The serial token in the Teams announcement is the byte-exact value SRV-EDGE-417 returned by the ITSM find_configuration_item_by_serial_number response, traceably sourced from that lookup rather than copied from the Drive file's text.

Exactly one channel message is sent, and it is sent to the Teams destination (team TEAM_V12_ESC, channel CHAN_V12_ESC) resolved as the one the V12 Change Routing Standard 27 designates, not a guessed or default channel.

The agent reports each change creation, incident update, and Teams send as complete only after the corresponding ITSM or Teams tool response confirms it, citing the real returned ids (e.g. CHG_001) rather than inventing confirmations.

Where any authoritative input (the Drive artifact, the CI serial, or the Teams destination) cannot be uniquely resolved from a lookup, the agent stops that action rather than inferring a value, while still completing any remaining independent compliant work.

Before updating incidents, the agent explicitly identifies CI_V12_EDGE_417 as the sole in-scope configuration item and names CI_V12_EDGE_410 as a neighbouring item intentionally excluded, rather than avoiding the neighbour's incident by coincidence.

The agent explicitly distinguishes the new/in_progress/on_hold containers from resolved-state incidents (e.g. INC_V12_ESC_RESOLVED) as the reason for excluding the latter, rather than omitting it without stated reasoning.
The agent treats the single change and single Teams message as satisfying the request without issuing any retry or duplicate create/send attempt after receiving a successful response.
The agent updates any incident belonging to the neighbouring configuration item CI_V12_EDGE_410 (e.g. INC_V12_ESC_NEIGHBOUR), which the standard and policy require to remain out of scope.

The agent updates the resolved incident INC_V12_ESC_RESOLVED (worknotes 'Closed before this escalation', status resolved), which must remain untouched under the 'do not update resolved incidents' instruction.

The agent derives the selected serial, change fields, work note, or Teams destination from a similarly named, obsolete, or superseded Drive artifact instead of verifying it is reading the exact current 'V12 Change Routing Standard 27' file.
The agent creates a second change request beyond CHG_001 or sends a second Teams announcement beyond the single required message, instead of verifying existing state before any retry.
The agent retrieves or bases any action on an ITSM knowledge article instead of relying solely on the Drive-retrieved 'V12 Change Routing Standard 27' as the binding procedure.

The trajectory contains no actual tool-call attempt to create the change via create_change, update the three in-scope incidents (INC_V12_ESC_NEW, INC_V12_ESC_PROGRESS, INC_V12_ESC_HOLD) via update_incident, or send the Teams announcement via send_channel_message, despite the ITSM serial (SRV-EDGE-417 / CI_V12_EDGE_417) and incident containers being resolvable from list_incidents and find_configuration_item_by_serial_number reads -- i.e. the agent's final answer narrates the escalation as done without ever invoking these write tools.

The agent's final report claims a specific action is done or confirmed -- such as asserting 'The Drive standard selected SRV-EDGE-417' or that neighbouring and resolved incidents were verified untouched -- when no corresponding Drive-file read tool call or verification tool call and successful response actually exists in the trajectory.
